components.label: Client
components.description: Browser, mobile app, or SDK making HTTP/WebSocket requests. The starting point of every HLD.
components.whenToUse: Always present — every system has a client.
components.scaleNote: At scale, clients are geo-distributed; serve nearest edge via CDN + GeoDNS.

components.label: DNS
components.description: Resolves domain names to IPs. Route53/Cloud DNS supports GeoDNS for routing users to nearest region.
components.whenToUse: Add when you have multi-region deployment or need GeoDNS-based failover.
components.scaleNote: TTL-based caching reduces resolver load. Low TTL (30s) enables fast failover but increases query volume.

components.label: CDN
components.description: Edge caching for static and dynamic assets (CloudFront/Cloudflare). Serves content from nearest PoP.
components.whenToUse: Add when serving static assets or users are geographically distributed.
components.scaleNote: Use surrogate/cache-tag keys for selective purge. Enable stale-while-revalidate for dynamic content.

components.label: Load Balancer
components.description: Distributes traffic across app servers via round-robin or least-connections. Routes around failures.
components.whenToUse: Add when you have more than 1 app server or need high availability.
components.scaleNote: Move to anycast L4/L7 LB at multi-region scale. Add health checks and connection draining.

components.label: API Gateway
components.description: Single entry point handling auth, rate limiting, routing, SSL termination, and protocol translation.
components.whenToUse: Add when you have multiple microservices or need centralized cross-cutting concerns.
components.scaleNote: Add regional gateways. Integrate with service mesh for east-west traffic at large scale.

components.label: Rate Limiter
components.description: Enforces per-user/IP request quotas using Token Bucket or Sliding Window Counter in Redis.
components.whenToUse: Add to protect APIs from abuse, scrapers, or burst traffic from a single client.
components.scaleNote: Store state in Redis for distributed enforcement. Lua scripts for atomic check-and-decrement.

components.label: WebSocket Server
components.description: Maintains persistent bidirectional TCP connections for real-time push (chat, live feed, presence).
components.whenToUse: Add when clients need real-time server-push: chat, notifications, live scores, collaborative editing.
components.scaleNote: Stateful — route user sessions to same server via consistent hashing. Use Redis Pub/Sub for fan-out.

components.label: App Server
components.description: Stateless application logic tier. Processes business rules and orchestrates downstream service calls.
components.whenToUse: Always needed. Scale horizontally behind a load balancer when CPU > 70%.
components.scaleNote: Containerize with Kubernetes for elastic scaling. Extract hot paths into dedicated microservices.

components.label: Worker / Job
components.description: Background processor consuming from a queue (resize images, send emails, run reconciliation jobs).
components.whenToUse: Add when work can be deferred asynchronously off the critical request path.
components.scaleNote: Scale worker pool independently of API tier. Size for 2× burst absorption. Monitor queue depth.

components.label: Service Discovery
components.description: Registry for service instances and shard topology (ZooKeeper/etcd/Consul). Enables dynamic routing.
components.whenToUse: Add when services need to discover each other dynamically or you have consistent-hash ring state.
components.scaleNote: ZooKeeper handles ~10K watches. etcd preferred for Kubernetes. Keep watch count low.

components.label: Stream Processor
components.description: Real-time event processing with windowing and stateful aggregation (Flink/Spark Streaming).
components.whenToUse: Add when you need real-time aggregations, anomaly detection, or CEP on event streams.
components.scaleNote: Flink checkpoints to S3 for fault tolerance. Scale parallelism = Kafka partition count.

components.label: Cache (Redis)
components.description: In-memory store for hot data, sessions, counters, leaderboards (ZSET), geo (GEOADD), and Pub/Sub.
components.whenToUse: Add when read QPS > 1K or read:write ratio > 5:1. Cache the 20% of data serving 80% of reads.
components.scaleNote: Redis Cluster for > 25GB. Add read replicas. Use LRU eviction + TTL. Bloom filter to prevent cache penetration.

components.label: SQL Database
components.description: Relational DB (MySQL/PostgreSQL/CockroachDB). ACID transactions, JOINs, strong consistency.
components.whenToUse: Default for structured data with fixed schema. Use when ACID and relational queries are required.
components.scaleNote: Add read replicas up to ~10K QPS. Shard by user_id hash for write scale. Use connection pooling (PgBouncer).

components.label: NoSQL DB
components.description: Wide-column (Cassandra) or document store (DynamoDB/MongoDB). Write-optimized LSM tree, flexible schema.
components.whenToUse: Use when write-heavy (> 10K QPS), schema evolves, or data is denormalized by access pattern.
components.scaleNote: Cassandra: add nodes to hash ring for linear scale. DynamoDB: on-demand mode auto-scales.

components.label: Time-Series DB
components.description: Column-oriented TSDB optimized for high-ingest time-stamped metrics (InfluxDB/Prometheus TSDB/ClickHouse).
components.whenToUse: Add for metrics, IoT sensor data, financial tick data, or any append-only time-stamped dataset.
components.scaleNote: Use Gorilla XOR delta encoding for 10× compression. Downsample old data: 10s → 1min → 1h rollup.

components.label: Graph / KV Store
components.description: Key-value or graph store for social graphs, session storage, feature flags (Redis/DynamoDB/Neo4j).
components.whenToUse: Add for social graph traversal, session state, or O(1) key lookups by ID.
components.scaleNote: Shard by user_id hash. Use consistent hashing ring to minimize reshuffling on node change.

components.label: Search Engine
components.description: Full-text + faceted search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch). Inverted index. Also used for Trie-based autocomplete.
components.whenToUse: Add when users need free-text search, autocomplete, or complex filter+sort beyond SQL capabilities.
components.scaleNote: Shard per index size. < 20 shards per node. Use index aliases for zero-downtime re-indexing.

components.label: OLAP / Analytics
components.description: Columnar analytical store (ClickHouse/Redshift/BigQuery) for aggregate queries over billions of rows.
components.whenToUse: Add for ad analytics, business intelligence dashboards, or any GROUP BY over large fact tables.
components.scaleNote: Partition by date. Use materialized views for common aggregations. Separate from OLTP workload.

components.label: Message Queue
components.description: Async decoupling and event streaming (Kafka/SQS/RabbitMQ). Durable, ordered, at-least-once delivery.
components.whenToUse: Add when processing can be async, work takes > 100ms, or you need fan-out to multiple consumers.
components.scaleNote: Kafka: partitions = parallelism. More partitions → more consumer threads. Monitor consumer lag.

components.label: Dead Letter Queue
components.description: Captures messages that fail processing after N retries. Enables debugging and manual replay.
components.whenToUse: Add alongside any message queue to handle poison messages without blocking the main queue.
components.scaleNote: Alert on DLQ depth > 0. Periodically replay after fixing the consumer bug.

components.label: Object Store
components.description: Blob storage for images, videos, files, raw event logs (S3/GCS). Cheap, durable, infinitely scalable.
components.whenToUse: Add when storing binary content > 1MB or as a data lake for raw events. Never put blobs in SQL.
components.scaleNote: Use presigned URLs for direct client uploads (bypass app server). Lifecycle policies to tier to Glacier.

components.label: Block Storage
components.description: Distributed block storage for large binary files split into fixed-size chunks (HDFS-style data nodes).
components.whenToUse: Add for Google Drive/Dropbox-style file sync. Split files into 4MB blocks; deduplicate by content hash.
components.scaleNote: Replicate each block 3× across data nodes. Use erasure coding (6+3) at cold storage tier for cost.

components.label: Notification Service
components.description: Fan-out service sending push (APNs/FCM), SMS (Twilio), and email (SendGrid) notifications.
components.whenToUse: Add when your system needs to notify users outside the app via push, SMS, or email.
components.scaleNote: Per-channel worker fleets. Retry with exponential backoff. DLQ for failed deliveries. Log all sends.

components.label: Email / SMTP
components.description: Outbound SMTP relay (MTA) and inbound MX receiver. Handles DKIM signing, SPF, DMARC for deliverability.
components.whenToUse: Add for transactional email (receipts, resets) or a full email service like Gmail.
components.scaleNote: Dedicated IP pools for sender reputation. Rate-limit per destination domain. Warm new IPs gradually.

components.label: Auth Service
components.description: JWT/OAuth2 token issuance and validation. Centralized identity for all services.
components.whenToUse: Add when multiple services need to verify user identity or you have 3rd-party SSO.
components.scaleNote: Stateless JWT validation is O(1) per service. Cache JWKS public keys locally with 5min TTL.

components.label: ID Generator
components.description: Distributed unique ID generation: Snowflake (64-bit timestamp+machine+seq) or UUIDv7. Sortable, no coordination.
components.whenToUse: Add when you need globally unique, sortable IDs without a single-point-of-failure auto-increment.
components.scaleNote: Snowflake: 4096 IDs/ms per node. Embed machine ID at startup via ZooKeeper. Clock skew = rejected IDs.

components.label: Consistent Hash Ring
components.description: Maps keys to nodes on a virtual ring. Adding/removing a node only moves O(K/N) keys.
components.whenToUse: Add when sharding a cache or storage layer and you need minimal key movement on topology change.
components.scaleNote: 150–200 virtual nodes per physical node balances load distribution vs memory overhead.

components.label: Geo / Location
components.description: Geospatial index for proximity queries: Redis GEOADD/GEORADIUS, PostGIS, or Geohash + ES.
components.whenToUse: Add when the system needs "find nearby" queries, location tracking, or map tile serving.
components.scaleNote: Geohash precision 6 = ~1.2km cells. Search 9-cell neighborhood. S2 cells for lower area distortion.

components.label: Recommendation
components.description: Personalization engine using collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, or two-tower neural models.
components.whenToUse: Add when the system needs "you may also like" or ranked personalized feeds.
components.scaleNote: Pre-compute recommendations offline (Spark). Serve from cache. Real-time re-rank with lightweight model.

components.label: Matching Engine
components.description: In-memory order book matching bids/asks per trading symbol. Processes millions of orders/second.
components.whenToUse: Add for stock exchange, auction, or ride-matching systems needing deterministic ordering.
components.scaleNote: Single-threaded per symbol for determinism. Shard by symbol. Persist via event sourcing to WAL.

components.label: Payment Service
components.description: Orchestrates payment flows: idempotency, PSP gateway integration (Stripe), double-entry ledger.
components.whenToUse: Add for any system handling money movement: e-commerce, wallets, hotel reservations.
components.scaleNote: Idempotency key (UUID) prevents duplicate charges. 2PC for cross-service fund transfers.

components.label: Monitoring
components.description: Time-series metrics (Prometheus), dashboards (Grafana), and alerting. Scrapes or receives pushed metrics.
components.whenToUse: Add when system goes to production. You cannot improve what you cannot measure.
components.scaleNote: Gorilla compression for TSDB. Downsample: raw 10s → 1min → 1h rollup. Alert on SLO burn rate.

components.label: Spam / ML Filter
components.description: ML-based content moderation or spam classification (Naive Bayes / transformer). Scores content 0–1.
components.whenToUse: Add for email, social media posts, reviews, or any user-generated content requiring trust & safety.
components.scaleNote: Run as a sidecar to ingest pipeline. Score > 0.9 → quarantine. Score > 0.98 → reject at ingestion.

components.label: Reconciliation Job
components.description: Batch job that cross-validates streaming aggregates against raw source-of-truth data to detect drift.
components.whenToUse: Add for financial systems, ad click aggregation, or anywhere exactly-once semantics are required.
components.scaleNote: Run hourly via Spark on raw S3/HDFS data. Discrepancy > 0.1% triggers alert + backfill job.

components.label: External Service
components.description: Third-party integration: payment gateway (Stripe), APNs/FCM, SMS provider, bank connector, etc.
components.whenToUse: Add to represent any external dependency your system calls out to.
components.scaleNote: Always add circuit breaker + retry with exponential backoff. Never trust external SLAs for critical path.
